texts.Name: Anton Dziatkovskii
texts.Tell us about something amazing you crea: I recently built an autonomous multi-agent AI 'fleet' at my lab (Palo Alto AI Research Lab): a small fleet of Macs and PCs running coordinated Claude-based agents that share one knowledge vault, message each other over a machine bus, self-schedule their routines, and ship open-source tooling to GitHub (github.com/tonydzi). It runs research, outreach and content pipelines end-to-end with me as the only human in the loop. More: https://tonydzi.github.io/
